news.body:
## Three things land on the 8th
- The 8th is a Sunday, so Friday is the last working day before it.
Your KITAS expires that day and both Google applications close that day. InCorp cannot confirm anything about the cancellation over a weekend, so tomorrow is the real deadline for the one thing you are waiting on them for. - Worth one call to Chitra tomorrow rather than another email.
- The Google Dublin and London applications have been at their start-by since Tuesday and neither has moved.
You filed the Amazon one early, so this is not about being unprepared. An hour each, with a CV that is already written. - Three days left, and you are the only thing in the way of both.
## Delhi's window runs out today
- Campus France Delhi asked for two to three working days, and today is the third.
You chased them again last night, which was right. A fourth mail is not. - If nothing arrives today, the call with Amanda Heurteau at INSEAD is the way round Delhi rather than through it.
